data.name: Dragon Riders
data.detailed_description:
A BL Ethical Gacha with Sentient Dragons Who Also Date Each Other!

You've bonded with a dragon and escaped the polluted wastelands. Now you just need to survive life in the Sky Nation that owns you.

Dragon Riders is a story-driven BL visual novel hybrid with romance, card battles, team-building, and gacha-style unlocks set in a world of stolen dragons and political secrets.

Wishlist to be Notified on Launch so you don't Miss the Launch Discount!

Gacha Without Microtransactions

Spin for dragons, riders, and cards using credits earned organically by reading the visual novel and playing the card battler. 

  • No Paid Pulls or Premium Currency

  • No Grinding For Credits or Waiting Days for Credits to Renew

  • No Freemium 'Pay to Win' or 'Real Money' Stores

  • NO MICROTRANSACTIONS!

Dragon Riders has 21 Dragons/Riders to Win, and Each Have Decks of up to 25 Different Cards!  

From Trash Heaps to Dragon's Wings

You play as Chance, an Ashford runaway surviving in the poisoned wastelands beneath Aetherium’s shining sky cities. When the Skyhelm Military forces him into the Dragon Trials, he bonds with Nightscale: a massive, sentient black dragon with missing memories and secrets everyone seems desperate to hide.

Their bond offers freedom, safety, and a life Chance never thought possible—until he realizes Skyhelm may be another kind of cage.

Does he accept his prison and couple with another rider so his dragon can have a mate? Or is he coupling with the best dragon rider to escape with?

Choose the Lover Who Shapes Your Future

Grow closer to a cast of male riders and learn their hidden agendas. Each want you and Nightscale to pick him and his dragon to partner with, but you must tread carefully. 

  • Warner - The kind, veteran, team leader who's fiercely loyal to Skyhelm. His dragon bond was his salvation.

  • Fangu - The quirky, loveable, cat-boy and his goofball bird dragon who have been stolen from their home nation.

  • Sabaste - The refined exiled prince of an enemy territory with a dragon who's losing his mind.

  • Komano - Your beefy bff from Ashford has been here a while--and doesn't seem to be holding together very well. 

Sentient Dragons Date One Another

When you date a rider, your dragons date each other.

The psychic bond you share with your dragon means a four-way bond is formed.  Rider dates rider and dragon dates dragon. 

Dragons are eager to find a mate, and you're eager to make your soul-bonded dragon happy. 

Be With Your Dragon Through a Four-Way Soul Bond!

When you date another rider, you bond with him and his dragon. Now you can share the thoughts and feelings of that rider's dragon, who is mated to your dragon. You're able to be in the mind of the other dragon!

Turn-Based Strategy Where You Build the Best Dragon Team!

  • Fine tune your dragon team to maximize Dragon Class effectiveness: Fire, Ice, Light Magic, Earth Magic, or Brawler.

  • Optimize your team each time you unlock more powerful riders and dragons.

  • Build your deck with stronger cards you win in the gacha

  • Design the best hand possible for each dragon

  • Feed your dragons the different foods you earn to level them and increase their power stats

The more characters you unlock, the more story episodes become available!

A Lore-Rich, Urban Fantasy World

The Verdant Coalition, Icehelm, The Pyrelands, The Mystic Octave, each nation has their own breed of native dragon--except one.  Aetherium placed progress ahead of environmental protection.  The result is that the most powerful nation has the fewest dragons.  

Now that dragons have become the ultimate war machines, Aetherium does what it must to maintain its military dominance--no matter who they must crush beneath their boots.

And yet, some dragons come to Aetherium for refuge from their even more terrible nations.  

Chance is getting his first taste of geopolitics in a country that prefers their population to stay ignorant.  The more he learns about his world, the more terrible his situation becomes.

Enjoy a Guiltfree Gacha!

  • Addictive BL Visual Novel Saga

  • Sentient Dragon Soul-Bounding

  • Card-Based Battles

  • Deck Building and Team Management

  • Gacha-Style Unlocks with No Microtransactions

  • Four Love Interest Routes

  • 21 Dragon/Riders Pairs to Unlock with 25 Cards Possible Each

  • Political Intrigue, Class Conflict, and Mysteries to Unravel!

Pick beefy Bara or a BL boyfriend! Card battles, team management, deck building, gacha unlocks, rich lore, dragon/dragon love, and BL or Bara romance!

content_descriptors.notes:
Dragon Riders takes place in a dystopian world with repression, poverty, factory enslavement, and totalitarianism. 

This is a 'gacha' game without microtransactions or any in-game real-money transactions. You play the gacha to unlock characters and their visual novel story routes.

Only in-game credits can be used, and are generously earned organically through the visual novel and card battler mechanics. No real-money gambling is possible.
